First Commonwealth Bank Announces Manager Appointment at Locust Street Branch


**CANTON, OH (November 23, 2026)** ― First Commonwealth Bank has announced the appointment of a new manager to its Locust Street branch, located at 2150 Locust St. in Canal Fulton.


Andrew Miller brings 13 years of banking experience and more than 25 years in management to the position.
A proven leader with a solid background across banking operations and team leadership, Miller is known for building strong customer relationships and developing high-performing teams.


“Andy’s customer-first approach and managerial experiences in banking will be great assets to FCB,” said Judy Ruff, First Commonwealth Bank’s Area Manager. “Andy’s familiarity with this market, combined with his experience in a financial-goal focused environment and administrative and managerial skills in the financial industry will be tremendous assets in this key role helping customers and businesses with their financial needs.”


Prior to his First Commonwealth appointment, Miller served as a Project Manager/Estimator for Hernandez Construction Services for a year after spending the previous seven years as a bank branch manager for two local community banks.


Outside of work, Miller is deeply connected to the community. He is an Eagle Scout and active supporter of local youth sports, serving as a youth baseball coach.


Miller and his wife live in New Franklin, Ohio, and have one son.


**About First Commonwealth Financial Corporation**


First Commonwealth Financial Corporation (NYSE: FCF), headquartered in Indiana, Pennsylvania, is a community bank committed to its mission of improving the financial lives of its neighbors and their businesses. First Commonwealth operates 126 branches throughout Pennsylvania and Ohio and also has business banking centers in Pittsburgh and Harrisburg, Pennsylvania; and Cleveland, Canton, Cincinnati and Columbus, Ohio. First Commonwealth, through subsidiaries First Commonwealth Bank and First Commonwealth Insurance Agency, provides a full range of commercial and retail banking services, including mortgage, wealth management and insurance solutions, along with equipment financing and SBA and indirect lending. For more information about First Commonwealth, visitwww.fcbanking.com .
